title: decode_body_value is on-demand; no decoding happens at parse time
description: Transfer-encoding decode and charset conversion are deferred to decode_body_value(), called explicitly by the caller. parse() produces only the structural tree and byte ranges. A future contributor might suggest decoding all parts eagerly at parse time to 'simplify' the API. That would be wrong: most callers only need one or two parts (e.g., the text/plain body), and decoding every attachment, every inline image, and every nested part is wasteful. The on-demand model also fits the intended use case of storing ParsedMessage in a database and only decoding bodies when a client requests them.
